title: Cold Cycle
logline: At 2 a.m. in an empty laundromat a stranger washes one red scarf; the woman folding clothes understands it is all he has left of someone.

bible.format: 16:9, 24 fps, 35 mm lens equivalent, shallow depth of field, soft natural film grain, restrained naturalistic colour, no stylised grading, handheld-steady realism
bible.set: a small 24-hour laundromat at 2 a.m. in the rain: south wall with a glass front door at the left end and a large rain-streaked shop window with a red neon glow; north wall with a row of five white front-loading washing machines numbered 3 to 7 (7 at the right end), a notice board with a yellow LOST CAT flyer above machines 3 and 4, a glowing blue vending machine and a green wall clock reading 2:04 at the east end; east wall with stacked steel dryers; west wall with a WASH & FOLD price sign and two orange plastic chairs; a steel folding table in the middle; pale grey vinyl floor
bible.geography: NORA stands on the north side of the steel folding table, in the aisle in front of washing machines 5 and 6, and stays on that spot. DEV stands at washing machine 7 at the east end of the aisle and stays on that spot. They are about one metre apart. Shots from NORA'S SIDE look west-south-west from just behind Dev's shoulder: behind Nora is the west wall with the WASH & FOLD sign and the two orange chairs. Shots from DEV'S SIDE look east-north-east from just behind Nora's shoulder: behind Dev are washing machines 6 and 7, the blue-glowing vending machine, the green wall clock and the stacked steel dryers. Never swap the two backgrounds. Keep every object where it is.
bible.lighting: The light never changes: cold overhead fluorescent light (about 5000 K) from above, warm red neon wash through the south window on the floor and the near edge of the table, a blue glow from the vending machine on anything near the east end; the same in every shot. Nobody touches a light switch. Only the red neon outside flickers once, in the first shot.
bible.performance: Naturalistic and restrained, like a film: micro-expressions, small hand movements, no grins, no wide-eyed shock, no big gestures. Nora is gentle and observant; Dev is hollowed out and polite. Nobody raises their voice and nobody cries openly.
bible.wardrobe_props: Nora: mustard raincoat worn open over a cream knit sweater, dark jeans, white trainers, dark hair in a loose bun with one strand free on the left, a pale blue towel in her hands. Dev: grey zip hoodie (hood down), dark jeans, wet black trainers, short damp dark hair, two-day stubble. Prop: one folded deep-red wool scarf with a frayed end, three brass laundromat tokens.
bible.set_short: a small laundromat at night: steel folding table in the middle, a row of white washing machines numbered 3 to 7 on the north wall, blue vending machine and green clock at the east end, stacked dryers on the east wall, WASH & FOLD sign and two orange chairs on the west wall, rain on the south window with red neon
bible.geography_short: Nora stands north of the table in front of machines 5-6; Dev stands at machine 7, about a metre away. Nora's side looks toward the west wall (sign and orange chairs behind her); Dev's side looks toward machines 6-7, the vending machine and clock behind him. Never swap backgrounds.
bible.lighting_rule: Unchanging cold fluorescent light from above, red neon wash from the south window, blue vending-machine glow at the east end. No switch is touched.
bible.wardrobe_short: Nora: mustard raincoat open over a cream sweater, jeans, white trainers, hair in a bun. Dev: grey zip hoodie (hood down), dark jeans, damp dark hair, stubble.
bible.performance_short: Naturalistic and restrained: micro-expressions only, no grins, no shock, no big gestures.

shots.intent: Establish the empty laundromat and Nora alone, folding.

shots.lighting: Unchanging; the red neon flickers once at 2.0 s.

beats.text: Nora folds a pale blue towel in thirds in a steady rhythm.
She smooths it flat with both palms and pauses, listening to the rain.
The red neon outside flickers once.
She lifts the towel, shakes it out and starts a new fold.
Her head turns a few degrees toward the door as a faint bell jingle sounds outside. No one speaks.

beats.text: Her hands keep folding while her eyes lift toward the door.
The door bell rings; her hands stop mid-fold.
Her eyes follow someone entering, tracking slowly across the room.
She breathes out slowly, looks back down at the towel and resumes folding. No one speaks.

shots.title: The Scarf
shots.intent: The audience sees the one thing he brought.
shots.start_state: Close on washing machine 7's round glass door with a white "7", and Dev's two hands at chest height opening a clear plastic bag.
shots.end_state: The drum door is closed and Dev's hand rests flat on the glass.

beats.text: He unrolls the top of the bag.
He draws out a deep-red wool scarf, folded, and holds it, his thumb on the frayed end, a beat too long.
He lowers the scarf into the open drum.
He closes the door; the latch clicks; his hand stays flat on the glass. No one speaks.
